title: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geome
question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, restricted to the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.

access_trace.sql:
WITH subject_counts AS (
  SELECT
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    ccs.SUBJECT_ID,
    SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
  JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
    ON ccs.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID
   AND ccs.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  WHERE tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS = 'Required'
    AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'
  GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccs.SUBJECT_ID
  HAVING SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) > 0
)
SELECT
  sc.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  EXP(AVG(LN(sc.record_count))) AS geometric_mean_record_count
FROM subject_counts sc
GROUP BY sc.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
